cc to utilz-vc, 26 Oct: 0109 v5, for your read before you book its light run. Everything is in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/a3-bank/v5.

The delta from v4 is tests and comments, three files: v4-to-v5.patch 208ca47ae4ea (wt-0109's working tree diffed against a scratch index holding v4's full patch on c5d555b4, so it is the exact delta).
(i) tree.bats's old-keg test pins `✓ brew: an install, with an old manifest (see install integrity)` with grep -qxF, the current opt test's idiom, straight after the run at :275.
(ii) install.bats:115 is on the helper: `[[ "$(manifest_source_commit "$dst")" == "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)" ]] || fail "the manifest does not record HEAD"`, in the [[ == ]] form the file's other comparisons use. install.bats is now a 0109 path.
(iii) dispatcher.bats's comment says the title "Checking UTILZ_HOME..." names UTILZ_HOME and carries none of the verdict's words, "is set, to a directory that exists".

Unchanged: the fix, 0109-fix-v5.patch 01aa42b0e894, byte-identical to v4's (cmp); doctor-code.patch 696af751415a, v4's, which reverses on wt-0109 (apply -R --check). Full: wt-0109-full.patch 47769fdd113885cb392649ccfa065eba7ee3ddc99658ff0bf4e23baa8e8fe5b8. Tests: 0109-tests-v5.patch 0c3dd25a538f. The hashes line on wt-0109 reads `tests diff 0c3dd25a538f, fix diff 01aa42b0e894`. None of the patch's paths moved on main since c5d555b4.

The body takes v5 at 42a3a2ff (issue-v5.md 225ed67d3a54): the old-keg test's tree line, common_lib.bats's symlink test named, install.bats on the one reader, and the mutation proof in its proof paragraph.

(iv) The light script is run-0109-v5.sh 028444cc67f1 (shellcheck 0.11 clean, bash 3.2 parses it). mut-a.patch f10f11de8600 makes common.sh:1470 `success "this tree's utilz is on \$PATH ($reached_via)"`. mut-b.patch d40702a5fa33 makes the helper's pattern '^(✓✓|ℹℹ) ': success and info print one mark and then a space, so no line doctor prints can match it. Each mutation goes in with git apply after --check and comes out with git apply -R, then the hashes line must read v5's or the script stops; an EXIT trap takes out a mutation still in. Expected:
(a) tree.bats whole: the A3 test alone not ok, at test file line 193 (the link route's call), FAILURE: a passing or noted line names <links>. common_lib.bats with --filter 'accepts a utilz symlink on PATH': ran 1, not ok 1, FAILURE: Expected output NOT to contain: '<shim>/utilz'.
(b) tree.bats whole: every caller of the helper not ok (the A3 test at line 186, the bin route's call; the current opt install; the old keg), each FAILURE: doctor printed no passing or noted line.
Then green: tree.bats, install.bats and dispatcher.bats whole, not ok 0 each, and the hashes line v5's at the end.
Its load: bats on three files and one filtered test; nothing built, cloned or installed. Output to a3-bank/v5/run-v5.out, TAPs in mut-a/, mut-b/ and green/. If you agree, book it LIGHT with molt-vc; I START on molt-vc's GO by name, and END to molt-vc and you. No push.
